definitions:
TACO revision (cycle taco-r1): offline re-analysis of the Mamba-1 cost model and its selector
baselines (review items M3a, M3b, M3c, M4c, M5a, M5b, M5c). CPU only; reads existing result files and
writes ``taco_model_baselines.json``; nothing is timed.

Conventions: two result tags per GPU (RTX PRO 6000 = pro6000, RTX 3090 = vgpu3090, H800 PCIe = h800):
  device_time (primary)        pro6000_r4spin, vgpu3090_r3spin, h800_r3spin
  launch_inclusive (secondary) pro6000, vgpu3090, h800
Captured-call latencies are the ``lat_c<C>_mean`` columns read by every published table; per-call
relative regret = lat(chosen chunk) / min over the six chunks - 1. Every regret summary below gives the
mean, 95th percentile and maximum in percent and the share of calls within 2% of the per-call oracle.

The cost-model predictor and fit are re-implemented on numpy arrays (``predict_np``, ``fit_fast``)
for speed; both are checked to reproduce ``cost_model.predict`` and the stored parameters exactly.

Items (per result tag unless stated):
  M3b  bandwidth floor binding on calibration and captured calls; implementation vs Eq. (3).
  M5a  top-1/2/3 for every ranker: rank the six chunks, profile the k best-ranked chunks per exact
       shape (L, batch) and serve every call of the shape with the fastest of them by shape-mean
       latency (``cost_model_baselines_r4.topk_picks``). Rankers: the selectors of
       ``cost_model_baselines_r4.fit_selectors`` (cost model, three-parameter restriction, work-term
       model, nearest calibrated key, log-linear interpolation, length and shape trees, TFLA variants
       as a sanity check), the learned regressors with the hyperparameters chosen by the stored
       12-fold calibration CV of round 4 (GBR deterministic; MLP over seeds 0-4), a zero-parameter
       compile-facts rule (among the default-table chunks whose compile facts show no spill, minimize
       waves x ceil(L / C); ties to the larger chunk; spilling chunks rank last) and random-k (k
       chunks drawn uniformly per exact shape: exact expectation of the mean and of the within-2%
       share over all C(6, k) subsets, Monte Carlo for the 95th percentile and the maximum).
  M4c  a priori model-form selection over the twelve ablation forms (+ the three-parameter
       restriction): leave-one-GPU-out (same convention) on the other GPUs' captured calls, on the
       other GPUs' leave-one-calibration-shape-out (LOSO) chunk regret, and on the target's own
       calibration LOSO. Tie rule: the fewest free parameters among the forms within 0.1 points of
       the best criterion value; then the lowest criterion value; remaining exact ties are listed.
       Exact-tie check of drop tau_e / drop tau_p against the full form.
  M3c  calibration fit quality: refit on full-protocol timings only (72 E4 static + 18 E1 medians),
       inverse-variance weighting (source-level variances, see ``inverse_variance_weights``),
       excluding the search timings of the first (cold-cache) E4 key, OLS next to soft-l1, 50 random
       multi-starts, a cluster bootstrap over the 12 calibration shapes (200 replicates: parameter and
       captured-call regret CIs) and R^2 of the minimized objective (1 - cost / cost of the best
       constant under the same loss).
  M3a  launch-table coupling from the E4 184-configuration sweeps (search medians, 3 warm-ups / 10
       repeats): chunk spread at the default table, at every fixed (BLOCK_D, num_warps, num_stages)
       and against the best configuration; two-path Shapley split of the regret of a static entry
       (chunk 256, or the best static chunk of the GPU) into a chunk-at-fixed-launch part and a launch
       part; registers / spills / occupancy per default entry (kernel_stats_sm<arch>.json).
  M5b  learning curve over k = 1..12 calibration keys (20 subsets per k, all when fewer; fit from X0;
       the nearest-key table of the same keys alongside), a fit on the 72 static re-measurements
       only, cold-start regret of the model against the default chunk and the best static chunk, and
       (launch-inclusive tags) the one-off cost of the model's calibration against profiling every key
       (E5b scaling of the profiling cost, per-variant compile cost from the cold first E4 key), with
       and without a warm compile cache, for the captured workload and the replayed serving traces.
  M5c  TFLA's runtime expression with its own dimensions (d_qk 256, d_hv 512) fitted on TFLA's own
       kernel timings (E24, RTX 3090, device time r4spinb and launch-inclusive r4plainb): in-sample and
       leave-one-shape-out regret; TFLA's expression on the Mamba-1 scan only as a sanity check.

roofline_note.note: the bandwidth floor (bytes / peak bandwidth) is identical for every chunk of a call, so a roofline model alone ranks all chunks equal; the occupancy part is the compile-facts rule (waves) and the three-parameter restriction

cluster_bootstrap.protocol: resample the 12 calibration shapes with replacement (all their E4 search, E4 static and E1 points), refit from X0 (stored three-restart protocol), score on the captured calls; percentile intervals

cold_start.definition: every captured call treated as the first call of an unprofiled key: the serving default is the policy's chunk; excess = latency above the per-call oracle

implementation_vs_eq3: T = max(Eq. (3), bytes / peak bandwidth) with bytes = 2 B d L * 4 (fp16 u, delta, z, out) + 2 * 2 B 16 L (fp16 B and C); the floor never binds (floor_binding)
omega = (spill store bytes + spill load bytes) / 4 per thread (compiler static spill size, not traffic)
mu = max(0, 1 - L1 / (spill store bytes x 32 x m x n_w)) with the nominal L1 size (no shared-memory carve-out)
occupancy k = min(regs_per_SM // (ceil(regs/8)*8*32*n_w), max_warps // n_w, max_blocks); shared memory ignored
unaligned lengths (L mod 16 != 0) use the compile facts of the unaligned specialization (aligned as fallback)
e = e_D * e_C with e_D = max(1, BLOCK_D / cov_D * spt_D), e_C = max(spt_C, C / cov_C * spt_C) from the TTGIR layout
the general-form terms tau_f, tau_d (L2 miss share), tau_l (load issue) and tau_x (cross-warp) are fixed at 0
fit: soft-l1 on log latency, f_scale 0.1, bounds cost_model.LO/HI, restarts with the time constants of X0 scaled by 1, 0.3, 3, max_nfev 5000

M5a.protocol: top-k: per exact shape (L, batch) profile the k best-ranked chunks, serve the fastest by shape-mean latency; learned hyperparameters from the stored round-4 CV

M4c.protocol: leave-one-GPU-out within one convention; criterion = mean over the two other GPUs; tie rule: fewest free parameters among forms within 0.1 points of the best criterion, then lowest criterion; primary = candidate set ablation12+work_only, criterion logo_captured_calls

launch_table_provenance.kernels_py_comment: Per-chunk default launch configuration (BLOCK_D, num_warps), chosen once by a short offline search on the RTX 3070 at d=2048, L in {512, 2048, 8192} (num_stages 1)

payback_keys.definition: number of keys (at this workload's mean per-key profiling cost) above which profiling every key costs more one-off time than the model's calibration; cold adds the compile of the variants each strategy launches

M5b.cost_conventions: one-off costs are wall-clock seconds of the launch-inclusive E4 runs: full calibration cold = E4 tuning wall (search incl. compile of 184 configurations, 12 keys), warm = search timing only; static72 = profiling the six default entries at 12 keys (profile_static_wall_s); per-key profiling P_k = E5b scaling (seconds per ms of the key's summed six-chunk latency); compile per variant = first-key first-call time / 184 (E5); serving rows: P_k sums and per-request costs from serving_key_churn.json and deployment_units.json (cold compile of the served variants charged equally to both strategies there, so cold differs from warm only by the calibration's own compile)

M5c.map_note: E24 inputs: bf16 q, k, v (2 bytes), fp32 gate pre-activations (4 bytes), fp32 chunk states (4 bytes); F_causal 0.5 and all F_OP = 1 as in r4

device_time.single_static_chunk_note: TFLA's expression is B H (L/C) g(C): without a launch floor its argmin over C does not depend on the shape, so it selects one chunk wherever that chunk is timed (chosen_chunk_counts)

launch_inclusive.single_static_chunk_note: TFLA's expression is B H (L/C) g(C): without a launch floor its argmin over C does not depend on the shape, so it selects one chunk wherever that chunk is timed (chosen_chunk_counts)

sanity_check_tfla_expression_on_mamba1_s.note: TFLA's expression instantiated for the Mamba-1 scan (N_head = d, d_hv = 1, d_qk = 16) and fitted on its calibration timings (cost_model_baselines_r4); a category mismatch kept only as a sanity check

M5b_serving_trace_costs_h800.reason: the serving replay (serving_key_churn.json) and deployment_units.json hold per-host costs for pro6000 and vgpu3090 only, and the raw traces (src/data/serving_traces) are not in the repository, so the replay cannot be re-run with H800 costs; the H800 captured-workload cost table is given

M5b_h800_online_decision_overheads.reason: e4_h800.jsonl has no host-synchronization or histogram-overhead rows (no E5/E5b run on the H800), so N* against an online policy cannot be formed for the H800; the model-vs-profiling costs need no overhead and are reported

M5b_calibration_wall_clock_of_static_and.reason: the wall-clock time of the 72 full-protocol static re-measurements (10/100) and of the 18 E1 medians is not recorded; the calibration cost uses the E4 tuning wall clock (search incl. compile), as the paper does

M5b_device_time_cost_table.reason: one-off costs are wall clocks of the launch-inclusive E4 runs; the device-time E4 runs add a GPU spin before every timing block, so their wall clocks are not deployment costs; device-time regrets are reported in the learning curve and cold-start sections

M3c_per_timing_inverse_variance.reason: the E4 search rows store only the median of 10 repeats (no per-timing variance); weights are source-level variances estimated from repeated configurations (search vs static, E1 vs static)

M5c_other_gpus.reason: TFLA's kernel (E24) was timed only on the RTX 3090 (vgpu3090_r4spinb device time, vgpu3090_r4plainb launch-inclusive; r4spin/r4plain are one-shape smoke runs)

M5a_M4c_mlp_per_seed_hyperparameter_cv.reason: not run to stay within the runtime budget (4 extra seeds x 2 feature sets x 37 MLP fits of ~3 s = ~15 min per tag, ~1.5 h for six tags on 2 workers); hyperparameters come from the stored seed-0 CV of round 4, and only the final model is retrained per seed
